# Test fixtures

`trace_full_ad077b.json` is one day's position history for a single aircraft (ICAO hex `ad077b`), taken from the
public [adsb.lol](https://adsb.lol) archive and used to test parsing and leg inference.

Contains data from adsb.lol, made available under the
[Open Database License (ODbL)](https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/). It is public ADS-B data broadcast by the
aircraft itself and contains no personal or patient information.
